about: M7 deliverable 3, KNOCKBACK, SHOVE AND KICK (Dom/Strategy 2026-10-27: 'best-in-class world leading combat for 2027, the wow in the fight itself'). PRESENTATION ONLY and opt-in: ?feel=kick (query/value below). The sim (duel.ts) already resolves a kick (move 'kick', a short cone, def.knockback steps, stagger ticks, vsGuard against a raised guard); this file says how the foe's RAGDOLL shows it: a kick is a short physical push by the kicker's mass and the target's stance that staggers or knocks down (rd.stagger / rd.knockdown('push') from @frankendom/physics, whose TABG-derived fall seconds are data/rules.json's package rows: push over 80 falls 0.5 s, down 2 s), and it opens a finisher window. Design references (public behaviour only): Chivalry 2 and Mordhau's kick (a short shove that staggers a guarding man and drops one caught open or mid-swing); TABG's push-versus-damage knockdown counter already in the package rows. FORCE: force = massRatio^massExp x stance multiplier; massRatio = kicker mass / target mass (massKg, clamped to massClamp). OUTCOME: force < knockdownAt = stagger, else knockdown (rd.knockdown('push')). PUSH: the impulse into the ragdoll's chest is impulsePerForce x force (clamped to impulseClamp), the shown push distance is distanceM[outcome] x force over pushS (velocity = distance / pushS). FINISHER WINDOW: after the outcome, the event carries window[outcome].lengthS starting window[outcome].startS after the kick (a knockdown's starts when he has fallen); nothing is drawn for it. PRESENTATION ONLY, PLACEHOLDER NUMBERS (Strategy and V3 Dev, 2026-10-27): the stagger / knockdown and the finisher window change the fight's outcome, so they will be the SIM's (V3 Dev's sim rows will replace these). Until then EVERY number here that decides an outcome is a placeholder: the masses (massKg: hero 85, pitborn 120, default 80), massExp, massClamp, the stance multipliers, knockdownAt, the push numbers and the finisher window rows. They pick what the ragdoll shows and what the event carries, and promise the player nothing: the event payload says presentationOnly: true, the sim has no knockdown and no window from a kick. The module emits ctx.emit(event.name, { outcome, finisherWindowS, presentationOnly: true, ... }) and keeps it on the page list `event.log`; it never writes the sim. SHOVE rows: a non-kick shove (the pommel strike) is a smaller push that never knocks down.

stance.about: PLACEHOLDERS (V3 Dev's sim rows will replace them): the target's multiplier on the force, by what he is doing when the kick lands (duel.ts Phase: guard = guarding, attack = midSwing, hurt / roll / backstep = recovering, anything else = open). A kick into a raised guard is braced.

track.about: the hook sees only the sim's events, so the stance comes from them: an AttackStarted by him is midSwing for swingS (ended by his AttackMissed / Hit), a Staggered or Parried on him is recovering for recoverS, a kick's own Hit flagged guarded is guarding; else open.

fall.about: the package's knockdown fall seconds (data/rules.json's package rows: knockdown.fall_seconds.push and .down), mirrored here for the presentation and pinned against the package by test/feel-kick.test.mjs

window.about: PLACEHOLDERS (V3 Dev's sim rows will replace them): seconds after the kick of the finisher window the event reports (no text cue is drawn: removed on Dom's word, 2026-10-27). Presentation only: the sim has no finish window from a kick today (its only one is a posture break).

shove.about: a non-kick shove, by sim move id: forceMult scales the kicker's force, canKnockdown false = it staggers at most. Opt-in under the same ?feel=kick.
